title: CPSC, Bunn-O-Matic Announce Recall of Home Coffeemakers
summary: The coffeemaker's plastic pour-in bowl and lid can melt or ignite due to an electrical failure, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.75 million.

title: CPSC, Mintek Digital Inc. Announce Recall of Portable DVD Player Batteries
summary: The battery can overheat and explode while recharging, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 116,000.

title: CPSC, Shindaiwa Inc. Announce Recall of Gas-Powered Hedge Trimmers
summary: The heat from the hedge trimmer's muffler can damage the fuel tank, cause a fuel leak and create a fire hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: CPSC, DeWALT Announce Recall to Repair Framing Nailers
summary: The contact trip on some of the nailers could malfunction and cause a nail to eject unexpectedly, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: About 250 (60 new and 192 reconditioned).

title: CPSC, HSN LP Announce Recall of Welbilt Electronic Pressure Cookers
summary: The lid on these pressure cookers can open prematurely while contents are under pressure, allowing hot contents to be expelled and causing a scald or burn injury to individuals in the immediate area. Units: About 3,900.

title: CPSC, MSA Announce Recall of Climbing Wall Descenders
summary: This product, which assists wall climbers during descent, has a faulty bearing that can cause the brakes to fail. When this occurs, wall climbers risk rapid descent, with no braking capability. Units: 783.

title: CPSC, Advanced Catalyst Systems, LLC Announce Recall to Repair Cheftech Gas Grills
summary: Advanced Catalyst Systems independently discovered that sustained strong winds blowing into the back scoop of the hood can force hot exhaust through the control panel and could cause it to overheat. title: CPSC, Generic Value Products Announce Recall of GVP Hair Straightening Irons
summary: The heated ceramic plates on these irons can loosen and detach during use, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of KitchenAid Coffeemakers
summary: An internal electrical component of the coffeemaker can overheat and ignite, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 529,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Expanded Recall of Select Model Year 2004.5 and 2005 ATVs
summary: Some 2004.5 and 2005 Model Year Sportsman, Scrambler 500 ATVs, Trail Boss and Magnum 330 ATVs were assembled with possibly defective Electronic Control Modules (ECM), which may fail and overheat. If this were to occur, excessive heat could cause a fire, possibly resulting in serious injury or death.

title: CPSC, Target Corp. Announce Recall of Birch/Bark Candles
summary: The birch and bark surrounding the candles can ignite, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 256,000.

title: CPSC, Prestige Toy Corp. Announce Recall of Spinning Water Teethers
summary: The plastic spinner in the center of the teether can break, causing small beads to fall out. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, American Promotional Events Inc. Announce Recall of Fireworks
summary: These fireworks devices could unexpectedly tip over during use, posing a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,000 units.

title: CPSC, Battery-Biz Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
summary: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Belkin Announce Recall of Batteries Sold with Bluetooth™ GPS Navigation System
summary: The battery can overheat, expand, and possibly rupture, creating an explosion or fire hazard. Units: About 10,300.

title: CPSC, DeWALT Announce Recall to Repair Air Compressors
summary: Due to a wiring insulation defect, the unit may pose a possible shock hazard. Units: About 3,840 units.

title: CPSC, FF Acquisition Wheeled Goods Corp. Announce Recall of Go-Karts
summary: The suspension assembly can crack, causing the rider to lose control of the go-kart. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Tahsin Industrial Corp. Announce Recall of Treestands
summary: The treestand's bracket can bend if not secured properly by a chain and if weight is applied. This can cause the chain to disengage from the stand, the stand to separate from the tree and the user to fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 480.

title: CPSC, Midwest Cannon Falls Announce Recall of Votive Candles
summary: The candles' wax can catch fire, causing a high flame. This can cause nearby combustibles to catch fire and result in burns to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Nashbar Direct Announce Recall of Bicycle Trailers
summary: The bicycle trailers can become unstable when changing directions, due to incorrectly assembled hitch mechanisms, posing a risk of injury to the riders. Units: 300.

title: CPSC, Shakespeare Fishing Tackle Division Announce Recall of Children's Fishing Poles
summary: The paint on the rods of these fishing poles contains lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 438,000.

title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Doorway Baby Jumpers
summary: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children. Units: 29,300.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores and Infantino Announce Recall of Fun Frog Soft Gyms
summary: A cap on the wire supports inside the soft gym's upright arms can detach, allowing the wire to poke through the fabric. This poses a laceration and puncture hazard to babies. Units: About 26,000.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Scooters and Mini Bikes
summary: If tires are over-inflated, the plastic rim within the wheel can break, causing the tire to rupture. This poses the risk of facial and hand injuries while inflating the tire. Units: About 29,000 scooters and 5,000 mini bikes.

title: CPSC, Jøtul North America Announce Recall to Repair Liquid Propane Fueled Stoves
summary: Movement or misplacement of the stove's burner can allow propane gas to settle in the heater, resulting in delayed ignition. The delayed ignition could shatter the door glass and pose a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,200.

title: CPSC, Razor USA Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
summary: A weld can break, causing the handlebar to detach from the scooter. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the scooter. Units: About 246,000.

title: CPSC, Razor USA Announce Recall of PowMax Battery Chargers Sold with Razor Electric Scooters, Motorcycles and Go Karts
summary: The battery charger can overheat and cause minor burns when touched. Also, nearby items can become damaged by the hot chargers. Units: About 584,000.

title: CPSC, Aristo Home and Garden Announce Recall of "Fire Stick" Multi-Purpose Lighters
summary: The lighters fail to meet federal safety standards because they lack child-resistant mechanisms. If young children gain access to these multi-purpose lighters, they can pose a fire hazard or burn risk. Units: About 36,000.

title: CPSC, The Perrigo Co. Announce Recall of Multivitamins
summary: The vitamins contain iron, but do not have child-resistant packaging, as required by federal law, which could cause serious injury or death, if ingested by a child. Units: About 14,000 bottles.

title: CPSC, CSK Auto Announce Recall of Aqua Water Scooters
summary: Hydrogen gas can build up in the battery compartment and cause the battery cover and the battery package to forcefully expel from the product, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, LG Electronics and Sears, Roebuck and Co. Announce Recall to Repair Refrigerators
summary: A faulty component in the condenser fan motor can short circuit. This could cause the condenser fan motor to overheat, posing a potential fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,800.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Outdoor Trunks
summary: A problem with the lid support on the trunk could cause the lid not to stay open, posing the risk of an impact injury to a child's head, fingers or hands. Units: About 80.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Toy Chests
summary: A problem with the lid support on the toy chest could cause the lid not to stay open, posing the risk of an impact injury to a child's head, fingers or hands. Units: About 5,800.
